entities.summary: Turkish Republic, a political institution in Cyprus during Divided Cyprus and EU Accession (1983–2004). Grew from Turkey launches military intervention; island is divided along the Green Line. Led to the emergence of TRNC Declaration and International Isolation and Annan Plan referendum: Turkish Cypriots vote yes, Greek Cypriots vote no.
